description: This file contains a test suite for the low_level_alloc component of the Abseil library, including memory block pattern checks, randomization, and arena management, executed before main() with a global constructor.

classes.name: BlockDesc
classes.description: Structure representing a memory block with pointer, length, and fill pattern.

classes.name: BeforeMain
classes.description: A static struct with a constructor that runs tests before main() begins.

methods.name: CheckBlockDesc
methods.description: Verifies that the memory pattern in a BlockDesc is intact.

methods.name: RandomizeBlockDesc
methods.description: Fills a BlockDesc's memory with a randomized pattern.

methods.name: Test
methods.description: Performs randomized allocation and deallocation tests on memory blocks, optionally using a new arena and malloc hooks.
